about.title: About Us
about.intro: An Arab-Islamic platform that combines the wisdom of Prophetic Medicine with the precision of Modern Medicine, using advanced Artificial Intelligence technologies.
about.missionBody: We believe that Prophetic Medicine is a great treasure that deserves to be presented in a contemporary, documented scientific manner. Our goal is to enable Muslims to benefit from this heritage without neglecting modern medicine, in a safe and easy-to-use platform.
about.value1Body: We rely only on authentic and good hadiths with full chains of narration, and we clearly distinguish between what is established in the Sunnah and popular experiences.
about.value2Body: We clarify contraindications and drug interactions, and warn against dangerous symptoms. We do not provide a diagnosis but rather indicative information.
about.value3Body: We strive to collaborate with specialists in Islamic sciences, modern medicine, and herbal medicine to ensure the quality and accuracy of the content.
about.contactSub: Have a suggestion or comment? We'd love to hear from you
about.footer: Sidr app is an indicative tool only and does not provide medical diagnosis. All information is for general educational purposes and does not substitute consulting a specialist doctor. Version 1.0

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At the Sidr app, we are committed to protecting your privacy and health data. This policy explains how we handle your information.
privacy.footer: Last updated: April 2026 — We reserve the right to amend this policy with notification to users of significant changes.
section1: Textual symptoms or descriptions you enter for analysis (processed instantaneously and not stored).
Images attached for analysis (sent directly to the AI model and not saved on any server).
We do not collect any personal data such as name, phone number, or email.
section2: Texts and images are sent directly to Google Gemini AI servers for analysis.
We do not have private servers to store your health data.
Analysis is done instantaneously, and no history of your previous inquiries is saved.
privacy.section3Title: How do we protect your privacy?
section3: Communication is fully encrypted via HTTPS protocol.
We do not sell or share any data with third parties.
We do not use tracking cookies for advertising purposes.
We do not require login or account creation.
section4: Images you upload are analyzed immediately and then automatically deleted.
We do not keep copies of your images on any server.
We recommend not attaching images containing clear personal information (face, ID cards...).
If personal information appears in the image, it is not saved or processed.
